steps.en: Officer assesses the details and approves as hirer or driver
steps.id: Officer menilai detail dan menyetujui sebagai hirer atau driver

steps.en: Decision form offers a Send Email/SMS option
steps.id: Form keputusan menawarkan opsi Send Email/SMS

steps.en: Officer chooses email and/or SMS and the furnished person as recipient
steps.id: Officer memilih email dan/atau SMS dan penerima hirer/driver furnished

steps.en: Officer picks a ready-made message advising the person to settle
steps.id: Officer memilih pesan siap pakai yang menyarankan penerima menyelesaikan notice
steps.why_en: Message templates are stored outside the repo, so whether they urge settling the notice cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Template pesan disimpan di luar repo, jadi belum bisa dipastikan apakah isinya menyarankan penyelesaian notice.

steps.en: System saves the approval, then sends the listed email and SMS
steps.id: Sistem menyimpan approval lalu mengirim email dan SMS dalam daftar

steps.en: Email and SMS go out and each send is recorded
steps.id: Email dan SMS terkirim dan setiap pengiriman dicatat
